guidance.instructions: Leave disabled unless the target supports metrics and you have arranged an appropriate private network.

fields.help: Expose metrics only on a network controlled by the operator.
fields.title: Enable metrics

guidance.instructions: Create and retain the password in your own password manager. Configurator does not generate it or install it on the target.

fields.help: Create a unique password for this service, not your hosting login. Enable secret entry first, or defer it and finish the incomplete draft locally.
fields.title: Local service password

guidance.instructions: These illustrative keys need an explicit mapping in a real target integration. Configurator only prepares them.

fields.help: Optional nested settings for an adapted service; omit the object to retain target-owned behavior.

properties.help: Optional log level for a compatible target. Review target logs for private data before increasing detail.
properties.title: Log detail

properties.help: Optional worker count. Example public value, 2; confirm the target supports it.
properties.title: Worker count

fields.title: Extended operations settings

guidance.instructions: Obtain a scoped service token through your issuer's documented administrator workflow. Ask that administrator about permissions and expiry; do not substitute the local service password. No provider documentation link is supplied because this neutral example names no provider.

fields.help: Leave absent unless adapting this example to a service with an external token issuer. This example includes no issuer or token endpoint.
fields.title: Optional issuer token

fields.consequence: Selecting extended activates metrics and nested operations settings; it does not start services or expose a network port.

guidance.instructions: Keep minimal unless you intend to review extended operations. Both modes still require the local service password.

fields.help: Minimal keeps the base configuration; extended makes optional operations settings available.
fields.title: Deployment mode

guidance.instructions: Use a deployment label, not a password or a private customer identifier.

fields.help: Choose a recognizable name for this deployment. Example public name, local-service.
